aesthetics.title: \text{One KS2 geometry evaluation}
aesthetics.description: Same equations as the direct map, with K=N=R and independent parameters per chart. The same chart parameters are reused at every geometry step.

aesthetics.title: \text{KS2Cell: 2 shared-parameter geometry steps}
aesthetics.description: The default KS2Cell has S=4, R=8 and geo_steps=2. Each addition is inside chart space. Geometry parameters differ between charts but are shared between steps. Projections have no bias. No outer residual or ReLU is included.

0.description: A learned linear map. The weight holds one value for every pair of an input position and an output position, and the map contracts the input against the weight over the input positions. The arrays are read from the tape, and they are shared by every position of the axes the map is broadcast over.
